comments.text:
for you cake
 cups flour
1 cup sugar
1/2 cup butter (soft)
2 eggs
1 cup milk
2 tsp baking powder
1 tsp vanilla extract
Pinch of salt
👨‍🍳 Steps:
Preheat oven
Set it to 180°C.
Mix butter + sugar
In a bowl, mix until smooth and creamy.
Add eggs
Add eggs one by one, mix well.
Add vanilla + milk
Stir everything together.
Mix dry ingredients
In another bowl: flour + baking powder + salt.
Combine everything
Slowly mix dry ingredients into the wet mixture.
Pour into pan
Grease a cake pan and pour batter in.
Bake
Put in oven for 30–40 minutes.
Check if done
Stick a toothpick in → if clean, it’s ready.
🍫 Optional:
Add chocolate chips 🍫
Add cocoa powder for chocolate cake
Put frosting on top
